concept: WAF: L7 protection against SQL injection and XSS
tests: What to add to an ALB to protect against web exploits like SQL injection.
expected: Associate AWS WAF with the ALB; managed/custom rules inspect HTTP(S). Triggers: "SQL injection", "common web exploits", ALB.
why_not: Shield Standard is DDoS, not exploits; NLB is L4 and doesn't inspect HTTP; Flow Logs are metadata only.
